origin.description: Replace one inclusive code-point range in each string.
origin.usage: str_sub(string, start = 1L, end = -1L, omit_na = FALSE) <- value

arguments.name: string
arguments.text: A character vector, or another vector that can be coerced to character.

arguments.name: start, end
arguments.text: Inclusive positions, or a two-column matrix passed as start. end is size-checked when start is a matrix and is not used as an end.

arguments.name: omit_na
arguments.text: When TRUE, a missing string or a missing index leaves that string unchanged.

arguments.name: value
arguments.text: The replacement text. A length-1 value is recycled.

origin.details: string, start, end, and value must share a size. A missing index with omit_na FALSE makes that element missing. The replacement does not keep names from string.
origin.example:
x <- "BBCDEF"
str_sub(x, 1, 1) <- "A"
str_sub(x, -1, -1) <- "K"
str_sub(x, -2, -2) <- "GHIJ"
str_sub(x, 2, -2) <- ""
cat(paste0("str_sub<- on BBCDEF returns ", x, ".\n"))

translation.description: Replace one range with stringi.stri_sub_assign. This is R's str_sub<-.

arguments.name: string
arguments.text: A string, NA, or a list of those.

arguments.name: start
arguments.text: A start position, a list of positions, a list of rows, an IndexMatrix, or a two-column dict.

arguments.name: end
arguments.text: An inclusive end. Size-checked and ignored when start is a matrix.

arguments.name: value
arguments.text: The replacement string or list of strings.

arguments.name: omit_na
arguments.text: True leaves a string unchanged when an index or the string is missing.

translation.details: The size check uses size_common on string, start, end, and value. A list of rows is a matrix, as it is for str_sub. The result is a new list.
translation.value: A list of strings after replacement.
translation.example:
from stringr.sub import str_sub_assign
text = "BBCDEF"
text = str_sub_assign(text, 1, 1, "A")
text = str_sub_assign(text, -1, -1, "K")
text = str_sub_assign(text, -2, -2, "GHIJ")
text = str_sub_assign(text, 2, -2, "")
print("str_sub<- on BBCDEF returns " + text[0] + ".")
